reply_text:
I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

That comes from this same channel, which he's a member of. On 2025-09-03 Priyanka reported label printing had stalled at the Tansley Parcel depots, with Southgate dispatch stacking totes beside door 4. She closed the incident at 18:43 that day, once Southgate had cleared the backlog.

Nobody in the channel gave a street address, and there are no Tansley account files I could check. So I told him that if he needs the full address, he'll have to get it from Priyanka or the account record.
